theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkovClass.wordBraid_inv {m : ℕ} (ℓs : List (Fin m × Bool)) :
MassTraceMarkov.wordBraid (List.map flipLetter ℓs).reverse = (MassTraceMarkov.wordBraid ℓs)⁻¹

theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkovClass.wordBraid_append {m : ℕ} (ℓs ℓs' : List (Fin m × Bool)) :
MassTraceMarkov.wordBraid (ℓs ++ ℓs') = MassTraceMarkov.wordBraid ℓs * MassTraceMarkov.wordBraid ℓs'

theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkovClass.letterBraid_flip {m : ℕ} (ℓ : Fin m × Bool) :
MassTraceMarkov.letterBraid (flipLetter ℓ) = (MassTraceMarkov.letterBraid ℓ)⁻¹
